notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls more creatures than you.
description:
Activate Beza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Beza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Beza trigger, causing you to create two 1/1 Fish creature tokens, and a Treasure token if an opponent controls more lands than you.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Beza.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Fish, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
